# The core pack

*Core* · version 1.0.0 · code `CORE`

## What it is

The base of the banking packs: the parties and the organisation every other pack refers to. Counterparties (with country of risk,
UEN, KYC and credit figures), counterparty groups, issuers, central counterparties, the bank's own legal entities, books and
portfolios, desks, traders, holiday calendars and clearing accounts. Every trade, netting set and risk result names its
counterparty, book or legal entity by the ids defined here.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `counterparty`

**Counterparty** · mnemonic `CPTY` · read through connector `reference-store`.

**Id:** field `COUNTERPARTY_ID`; pattern `^CP-`; for example `CP-ALDERSHOT`.

Fields, from 18 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COUNTERPARTY_ID` | string | `CP-ALDERSHOT` | The document's id |
| `NAME` | string | `Aldershot Pension Trust` | Name |
| `LEI` | string | `549300H5KZ2QJHEAMB55` | LEI |
| `RATING` | string | `AA-` | Rating |
| `SECTOR` | string | `Pensions` | Sector |
| `COUNTRY` | string | `GB` | Country of incorporation (ISO 3166 alpha-2) |
| `TYPE` | string | `Pension fund` | Type |
| `COUNTRY_OF_RISK` | string | `GB` | Country of risk |
| `UEN` | string | `UEN0100037` | UEN |
| `ECONOMY` | string | `ECON-GBR` | The country of risk's economy (world-economy pack, when it is on) |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | `NEWS-Aldershot_Pension_Trust` | Its headlines (news-and-markets pack, when it is on) |
| `NET_MTM` | integer | `15036789` | Net MTM |
| `NETTING_SETS` | list of objects |  | Its netting sets (trades, net MTM); their exposure is computed (EXP NSET:<id>), not stored |
| `KYC` | object |  | Know-your-customer record (status, risk rating, last review, EMIR classification, one-year PD) |
| `GROUP` | string | `GRP-ALDERSHOT` | link to `counterparty-group` |
| `CREDIT_LIMIT` | string | `LIM-ALDERSHOT` | Its credit limit (USD) |
| `HIERARCHY` | object |  | The group, agreements and netting sets above and below it, as nodes and edges for the hierarchy panel |
| `CREDIT_CURVE` | string | `CDS-CASCADIA` | Its credit curve (market-data pack) (in 39%) |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `NETTING_SETS[]` | `ID` (string), `AGREEMENT` (string), `TRADES` (integer), `NET_MTM` (integer) |
| `KYC` | `STATUS` (string), `RISK_RATING` (string), `LAST_REVIEW` (date), `EMIR_CLASSIFICATION` (string), `PD_1Y` (number) |
| `HIERARCHY` | `NODES` (list of objects), `EDGES` (list of objects) |
| `HIERARCHY.NODES[]` | `ID` (string), `LABEL` (string), `TYPE` (string) |
| `HIERARCHY.EDGES[]` | `FROM` (string), `TO` (string), `LABEL` (string) |

Links: `GROUP` → `counterparty-group`.

## Screens and commands

| Command | Kind | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| `CPTY` | `counterparty` | Counterparty |
| `GRP` | `counterparty-group` | Counterparty group |
| `ISS` | `issuer` | Issuer |
| `CCP` | `ccp` | Central counterparty |
| `LE` | `legal-entity` | Bank legal entity |
| `BOOK` | `book` | Book |
| `DESK` | `desk` | Desk |
| `TRDR` | `trader` | Trader |
| `CAL` | `calendar` | Holiday calendar |
| `CLR` | `clearing-account` | Clearing account |
| `CORE` | — | The pack's overview: its kinds, how many each holds, an example of each |

Examples:

| Type | Shows |
|---|---|
| `CPTY CP-NORTHBRIDGE` | Counterparty · netting sets, KYC, rating, country of risk |
| `LE LE-NY` | Bank legal entity · New York |
| `BOOK BOOK-RATES-1` | Book · top trades, MTM, DV01 |
| `DESK DESK-RATES` | Desk · books, VaR |

Screens (Sutras):

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `clearing-account` | `clearing-account` | An account at a CCP holding cleared trades and margin. |
| `ccp` | `ccp` | A clearing house with its default fund and margin model. |
| `counterparty-group` | `counterparty-group` | Economic group of related counterparties (obligor group). |
| `counterparty` | `counterparty` | A legal entity the bank trades with: identifiers (LEI, UEN), rating, sector, country of risk and parent group. |
| `issuer` | `issuer` | Issuer of bonds and reference entity for CDS. |
| `calendar` | `calendar` | Business-day calendar (USNY, TARGET, GBLO, JPTO…). |
| `book` | `book` | A trading book: owner desk, trades and risk. |
| `desk` | `desk` | A trading desk: books, limits and risk results. |
| `legal-entity` | `legal-entity` | The bank's own booking entity. |
| `trader` | `trader` | A trader and their books. |

## Data sources and licences

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Synthetic sample data (tools/packgen/banking) | Proprietary (part of Drishti); fictitious names and figures | no | every document in samples/ and the demo lake |

Every kind's data contract (each column: type, key, example, links) and where its data comes from (an external source and its refresh script, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are in the guide, [guides/core.md](guides/core.md): *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reference-store` | `delta` | `counterparty`, `counterparty-group`, `issuer`, `ccp`, `legal-entity`, `book`, `desk`, `trader`, `calendar`, `clearing-account` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_DELTA_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`.

## Refreshing the data

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/banking/make_docs.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
